channel.title: Developer Tools Hub — New Tools
channel.description: Free online developer tools by Chesten. New tools added regularly.

item.title: API Tester — Free Online REST API Testing Tool
item.description: Test REST APIs with method selector, headers, auth, and response viewer. Like a mini Postman in your browser.

item.title: Favicon Generator — Free Online Favicon Maker
item.description: Generate favicons from text or emoji. Download as PNG, ICO, or ZIP. 20 preset styles included.

item.title: CSS Grid Generator — Visual Grid Layout Builder
item.description: Build CSS Grid layouts visually. Click to merge cells, export CSS + HTML code. Includes 6 presets.

item.title: SVG Path Editor — Visual SVG Path Tool
item.description: Edit SVG paths with drag-and-drop control points. Supports all path commands. 6 preset shapes.

item.title: Markdown to HTML Converter
item.description: Convert Markdown to HTML with live preview. 5 templates included. Download as HTML file.

item.title: GitHub README Generator
item.description: Generate beautiful GitHub READMEs with form-based editor. 6 templates: CLI, Web App, Library, Extension, API.

item.title: Open Graph Preview — OG Meta Tag Tester
item.description: Preview and test OG meta tags. See Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn card previews. SEO suggestions.

item.title: HTTP Status Codes — Complete Reference
item.description: Complete HTTP status code reference with descriptions, causes, and fixes. Live search and category filtering.
